scope: Website Foundations React and Vite deployment

git_behavior.production: Pushes or merges to the configured production branch create production deployments.
git_behavior.preview: Other branch pushes and pull requests create preview deployments by default.

vercel.spa_route_gate: Directly open and refresh a valid nested route. Use an SPA rewrite when the provider returns a 404 for valid client-side routes.

expected_vite_settings.port_requirement: Listen on the Railway-provided PORT and a publicly reachable interface.

railway.public_access_note: A deployed service is not necessarily public until a Railway-provided or custom domain is added.
custom_domain_flow: Wait for verified status and HTTPS
railway.custom_domain_gate: Both CNAME and TXT records are required in the current official dashboard flow.
